lumen_rigs.screen.mode.manual.hint: Points where the pan and tilt sliders say.
lumen_rigs.screen.mode.point.hint: Stays on the spot picked with the lighting remote.
lumen_rigs.screen.mode.follow.hint: Tracks the mob or player picked with the lighting remote, or the nearest player.
lumen_rigs.screen.mode.sweep.hint: Swings left and right around the pan and tilt.
lumen_rigs.screen.aim_at_me.hint: Points the fixture at your face.
lumen_rigs.screen.pan.hint: Turn left and right. Dragging it takes the aim back from the remote.
lumen_rigs.configuration.title: Lumen Rigs
lumen_rigs.configuration.remoteRange.too: How far the lighting remote reaches: linked fixtures and aimed blocks, in blocks.
lumen_rigs.configuration.followRange.too: Fixtures stop following an entity that is further away than this, in blocks.
lumen_rigs.configuration.lighting.toolti: Let fixtures light up blocks and mobs. The light is client-side: it does not stop mobs from spawning.
lumen_rigs.configuration.colorStrength.t: How strongly colored light tints what it hits.
lumen_rigs.configuration.maxLights.toolt: At most this many fixtures (the nearest ones) light up the world at once. Moving lights re-render the chunks they reach, so lower this on weak computers.
AUTO uses Veil's per-pixel lights (with shadows and volumetric beams) when Veil is installed, otherwise the built-in block light. BLOCK_LIGHT always uses the built-in one.
